content: For a 5-screen offline-first app with 2 state domains (auth session + entries/categories) and user-driven low-frequency updates, React Context + hooks is sufficient and idiomatic (matches official React guidance: Context for low-frequency state; reducer+context for shared write logic). Zustand 5.0.14 is the lightweight upgrade path if state grows; Redux Toolkit unnecessary at this scale. Decision is engineering judgment, not library-mandated.
